thesis: Q1 2026 earnings beat: $1.006B revenue (32% YoY growth), EPS $0.60 beat by 17.65%. First ever $1B quarter. AI observability platform leader — critical infrastructure for cloud monitoring at hyperscalers and enterprises. Raised FY2026 guidance to $4.30-4.34B. FedRAMP High certification opens US federal market. New products: MCP Server, Bits AI Security Analyst, GPU Monitoring. 44 analysts Strong Buy. Multiple AI and cloud migration tailwinds.

Rezdiffra (resmetirom) is the first and only FDA-approved treatment for MASH (metabolic-associated steatohepatitis with liver fibrosis). Q1 2026 net sales $311M (+127% YoY), achieved blockbuster status with $1.1B TTM revenue, 42,250+ active patients — still early in penetration of a massive underserved market. ARO-PNPLA3 pipeline license expands MASH coverage to high-risk Hispanic populations. Truist raised PT to $709 (from $640) on May 13, 2026. No direct competition approved for this indication.

Q1 FY2027 record revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY), EPS $1.87 beating consensus $1.76. Data center $39.1B (+69% YoY), representing 87% of total revenue. Q2 FY2027 guidance $91B (ahead of $87.2B consensus, +95% YoY). AI infrastructure backbone — Blackwell GPU platform dominates hyperscaler capital expenditure. $150B Taiwan investment reinforces supply security. Next frontiers: robotics, edge AI, autonomous vehicles. 62 analysts Strong Buy. Market cap $5.28T.

Oil price structural support from Strait of Hormuz closure (ongoing since Feb 28, 2026). Q1 2026 EPS $1.06 vs $0.60-0.64 expected — massive beat; free cash flow $1.7B (+52% YoY). Debt reduction: $20.8B to $13.3B since Q3 2025. Berkshire Hathaway backing as floor. Analyst PTs: Barclays $72 (Overweight), Mizuho $75 (Outperform), Raymond James $75 (Outperform) — 26-31% upside from current. RISK: Iran-US peace deal could end Hormuz closure and reduce oil price tailwind. CEO Vicki Hollub retiring June 1, COO Richard Jackson taking over.

Dominant global payment network with near-monopolistic moat (Visa + Mastercard handle ~80% of card transactions globally). Q2 FY2026: revenue $11.2B (+17% YoY), EPS $3.31 non-GAAP beat. Raised full-year FY2026 guidance. $20B buyback authorization reinforces shareholder return commitment. Expanding into stablecoin settlement (digital dollar rails) and agentic commerce programs — long-term structural growth. Low cyclicality, pricing power, asset-light. 38 analysts Strong Buy, avg PT $398.74 (+22% upside from current $326.98).
